card.name: Words that lead into 'blood'
card.fires_on: Words where the next word could plausibly be 'blood', such as 'with' after 'clothes', 'that' after 'urine', or 'an' after 'blood concentrations when'. It also fires on some numbers and punctuation in lab ranges.

modes.label: Linking word before blood
modes.description: A small linking word after a noun where 'blood' or a bodily fluid could come next.
modes.example: Horse-drawn vehicles splashed clothes<< with>> mud.

modes.label: Lab values and ranges
modes.description: Digits, colons or dashes inside iron or TIBC reference ranges.

modes.label: Sweat or bodily fluid
modes.description: A word describing a body dripping with fluid, where blood might be expected.
modes.example: my face is<< dripping>> with sweat

card.writes: It lowers the odds of the word 'blood' (in English and Chinese) as the next word.
